newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai New Asia to issue 25 million A shares.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai New Asia to issue 25 million A shares.

text.p: Hotel group Shanghai New Asia (Group) will soon issue 25 million domestic A shares and list them on the Shanghai stock exchange, a company official said on Monday.
The official declined to give the issue price of the shares, which include six million shares issued to employees in 1993.
Shanghai New Asia has listed 100 million foreign currency B shares on the Shanghai exchange.
Shanghai New Asia, whose main business is operating hotels in Shanghai, posted 43.9 million yuan net profit in the first half of 1996, up from 40.4 million yuan in the same 1995 period.
